title: Preserve a focused native draft through reconnect
description: Run native-draft-proof.mjs setup against the private gateway first. Set NATIVE_COMPANION_DRAFT to the draft recipe parameter. The transport closes while the real typed composer remains focused.

open.intent: Open the exact private native session without prefilling its composer.

wait-identity.intent: The selected conversation has replayed its live gateway identity before editing.

compose.intent: An unsent instruction exists through native keyboard editing and remains focused.

drop-focused.intent: Verify the exact text is focused, close the private mobile socket and observe a real reconnect.

restored-draft.intent: The remounted conversation must restore every typed character without a prior blur.

verify-unsent.intent: Prove through gateway reads that the draft did not submit a command or answer a request.

capture.intent: Record the restored unsent draft in the reconnected conversation.
